_meta.note: Licensing/risk register + thumbnail-recovery manifest for the games whose thumbnails fell back to the initials tile. Consumed by tools/fetch_thumbnails.py. Match on game_id, NEVER on title (Vex 3/9/X3M are the same series by the same author).
_meta.verification: Re-verified 2026-07-27 from an UNRESTRICTED network against the live ZoFHub catalog. This supersedes an earlier pass whose sandbox denied egress to every relevant host (x-deny-reason: host_not_allowed) and therefore could not test any URL.
_meta.root_cause: Not a licensing gate. The stored GameDistribution URLs use the extension '-512x384.jpeg', which returns HTTP 403 AccessDenied from their S3 bucket. The SAME asset at '-512x384.jpg' returns a real JPEG. A one-character extension difference accounted for 7 of the 13 broken thumbnails.
_meta.referer_finding: GameDistribution's img CDN is NOT referer-protected: identical requests with no Referer, a google.com Referer, and a zofhub.com Referer all behave the same. The 403 is per-object (AccessDenied on missing keys), not hotlink protection. onlinegames.io IS protected — it returns a ~17.5KB WAF challenge page on every path shape.
_meta.policy: Recovered art is DOWNLOADED AND SELF-HOSTED to public/thumbs/, never hotlinked. Self-hosting is what removes the referer dependency, the silent-deletion failure, and the ad-blocker breakage on img.gamemonetize.com.

gamedistribution.license_basis: Publisher agreement grants a non-exclusive, limited, non-sublicensable, non-transferable sublicense to make Games available on Publisher Properties, conditional on continuously meeting the agreement terms.
gamedistribution._pattern_note: Ordered best-first. '.jpeg' variants are dead across the board; keep '.jpg'. If GD rotates the scheme again, add the new shape here — the tool probes this list in order and validates real image bytes.

gamemonetize._feed_note: Feed is genuinely public — verified 200, ~4.2MB, 5001 items, no auth. Its 'id' field is a NUMERIC id (e.g. 35616), NOT the embed hash; the hash appears only inside the 'url'/'thumb' fields, so the tool indexes by hash extracted from the URL.

y8.license_basis: Y8 offers games for hosting on publisher websites at no cost; feed exposes a thumbs object (graphic_288x192, screenshotPath) plus iframeUrl.
y8._note: ZoFHub already self-hosts 28 y8 thumbnails; tools/fetch-y8-thumbs.mjs re-resolves them from each game page's og:image when a stored URL goes stale.

onlinegames_io._note: Hotlink/WAF protected — every media path returns a ~17.5KB challenge page instead of an image. There is no unauthenticated route to this art. ZoFHub already treats this host as fully blocked for recommendations.

games.title: Suroi
risk_flags: ZoFHub sources this tile from onlinegames.io, which is WAF-blocked — no unauthenticated fetch succeeds.
The game is GPL-3.0 (github.com/HasangerGames/suroi): commercial use permitted, but you must preserve copyright notices and license terms.
MIXED ASSET PROVENANCE: repo credits show art from many contributors plus third-party sources (Forest Camo body is a Freepik vector whose redistribution terms do not cleanly inherit GPL).
No 4:3 gameplay art exists in the repo - only logos and favicons.
Do NOT hotlink raw.githubusercontent.com: violates GitHub ToS on CDN use and is not a stable URL.
Cleanest route: self-host your own gameplay screenshot from the GPL build into public/thumbs/suroi.jpg.

games.title: Bloxd.io
risk_flags: PROHIBITED: bloxd.io terms grant permission to download one copy for personal, non-commercial transitory viewing only, and expressly forbid using the materials for any commercial purpose or for any public display.
This constrains more than the thumbnail — ZoFHub embeds and monetizes this game. Consider a 'remove' rule in catalog-overrides.json rather than only leaving the tile blank.
Proprietary, no press kit, no commercial asset license. Cannot be filled legitimately without written permission from the rights holder.
